facts.fact: 叙述者自称是科学家——她至少还认得出这一点。
facts.anchor: I was a scientist. I knew that much.

facts.fact: 她在 Wünder 的冰冻荒原上被人发现时濒死；醒来之后，情节记忆（episodic memories）一片空白。
facts.anchor: I was simply found near-death in the frozen wastelands, and upon waking, had discovered that I had none of my episodic memories.

facts.fact: 她的假设是：身份与所在的地方绑定，只有回到自己的世界才能想起来；她明说这是尚未验证的假设。
facts.anchor: It was a hypothesis I had yet to test.

facts.fact: 她动手去修一只小钟，理由是要确认「有些钟我还修得好」；同时开口讨要另一只黄铜发条。
facts.anchor: Shaking my head to clear it, I pushed my sleeves up in determination. I set to repairing a broken, smaller timepiece, if only to reassure myself that there were some clocks I could fix. “By the way, could you find me another brass mainspring?”

facts.fact: 猫起疑并点破：她又跑去了 Tulgey Woods，而那地方危险。
facts.anchor: “Don’t tell me you’ve been going to Tulgey Woods again. That place is dangerous.”

facts.fact: 她给森林那边修自己装过的预警系统，自称附近唯一的工程师，并说 Jabberwocky 不会为任何人停下，否则更多生物会被吞掉。
facts.anchor: Besides, I needed to fix that early warning system I’d installed for them. I’m the only engineer anywhere remotely close, and you know that Jabberwocky doesn’t stop for anyone. Otherwise, more creatures would have been gobbled up.

facts.fact: Duchess 一句「那就别被人看见」之后打了个响指：爆响、亮光、疾风之后，她只剩一身衬裙站在房间中央。
facts.anchor: When she snapped her fingers, there was a loud pop, a bright light, a gust of wind—and then I was standing wearing only my shift in the middle of the room.

facts.fact: 章末猫对 Allie 说：「你永远说不准，这一切也许仍是一场梦。」
facts.anchor: You never know, Allie. This could all still be a dream.
